rationale: C05 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It uses the same distinctive three-recital sequence identifying a railway dispute, failure of adjustment under the Railway Labor Act, and the National Mediation Board's judgment that interstate commerce and essential transportation service are threatened. It then contains the same two operative provisions: a report to the President within thirty days and a section 10 prohibition on changing the disputed conditions until thirty days after the report. The child adapts this machinery from one carrier and union to numerous carriers and three unions. C15 is an almost equally strong parallel, while C13 shares only generic recital-and-order structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.explanation: Exact shared recital language central to invoking the emergency railway-dispute procedure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the national Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the national mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce within the States of Illinois and Wisconsin to a degree such as to deprive those States of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves the distinctive finding and merely broadens the geographic target.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The principal reporting provision is identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by any of the carriers involved or their employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Chicago, North Shore & Milwaukee Railway Company or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The same statutory standstill mechanism and nearly identical wording are adapted from a named carrier to the child's multiple carriers.
